content: No headless/batch ABBA registration API is documented for Fiji; ABBA's registration steps (DeepSlice, Affine, Spline, BigWarp) are GUI/manual by design in the standalone Method-2 install. The only scriptable post-registration piece is qupath.ext.biop.abba.AtlasTools (loadWarpedAtlasAnnotations, getAtlasToPixelTransform) used already in 01_load_abba_rois.groovy -- confirms registration itself stays GUI-mediated per CLAUDE.md; only ROI-loading/labeling is scriptable.
